extras.notes: exterior with shallow interiors: two large display windows with clear glass and shelves of cans, jars, small sacks, boxes and fabric rolls behind, glazed double door with transom, red and cream striped fabric awning on iron rods. Sign with a sack and barrel pictogram (no text). Barrels, burlap sacks, crates and an apple crate on the boardwalk. Boardwalk 2 m deep, top at 0.4 m, fits the Cozy Wild West street grid.
